LOOK: Students of the University of the Philippines Visayas (UPV) staged a campus-wide walkout on Monday, October 6, in front of the New Administration Building at the Miagao campus.

Led by the UPV University Student Council, the protest called for the proper allocation of government funds, particularly for education.

Participants also demanded accountability from public officials amid reports of poor or unfinished flood control projects.

The demonstration followed a previous anti-corruption protest held on September 21 in Iloilo City, which coincided with the commemoration of Martial Law.

📷 University of the Philippines Visayas/Facebook

data.raw_text:
UP VISAYAS STUDENTS, NAG-WALK OUT PARA SA PROPER GOV’T FUND ALLOCATION

Nagdaos ng campus-wide walkout ang mga estudyante ng University of the Philippines Visayas (UPV) ngayong Lunes, Oktubre 6, sa harap ng New Administration Building sa Miagao Campus.

Sa pangunguna ng UPV University Student Council, nanawagan ang mga estudyante ng tamang paglalaan ng pondo ng gobyerno, lalo na para sa edukasyon.

Kasama rin sa kanilang panawagan ang pananagutan ng mga opisyal kaugnay ng mga ulat ng mga palpak o ‘ghost’ flood control projects.

Ang kilos-protesta ay kasunod ng isang anti-corruption rally na isinagawa noong Setyembre 21 sa Iloilo City, kasabay ng ika-53 anibersaryo ng deklarasyon ng Martial Law.

📸 University of the Philippines Visayas / Facebook

#PilipinasToday
#UPVisayasStudents
